comparison.objective: Dials a three-number padlock combination and pulls the shackle open; the candidate adjusts and locks industrial gripper hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2158 requires precise multi-turn dial control with reversals and regrasping on a swinging body; the candidate requires coupled two-tool countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2158 checks successive wheel-gate alignment, shackle release, remaining on the hasp, and released stillness; the candidate checks locked opening angle and repeated cycles.
comparison.reason: Rotary precision is the only generic commonality; the mechanisms, required coordination, and success outcomes differ materially.
